title: Seeding and Culturing Adherent Cells on 3D Broccoli-Based Scaffolds
author: Catherine A. Sword

steps.title: Prepare Fibronectin Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 μg/ml solution of human plasma fibronectin (Corning Catalog #354008) in sterile Dulbeccos Phosphate-Buffered Saline no calcium no magnesium (DPBS-/-) (Gibco - Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #14190-144), making 200 µL for each scaffold.

steps.title: Transfer Scaffolds to Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer scaffolds into individual wells of a 96-well plate using forceps.

substeps.instruction: Grip the flat faces of each scaffold with enough force to hold them without crushing or damaging them
Optional: Pour scaffolds into a sterile dish (e.g., Petri dish) first to facilitate easier transfer from storage tubes

steps.title: Incubate Scaffolds
steps.instruction: Incubate the scaffolds using one of two methods:

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 1 hour at 37 °C in a cell culture incubator
Alternatively, seal the plate with parafilm and incubate overnight at 4 °C

steps.title: Aspirate PBS
steps.instruction: Aspirate the PBS from the wells, ensuring the aspirator tip does not touch the scaffold.

substeps.instruction: For 6.5 mm scaffolds that occupy the bottom of the 96-well plate, tilt the plate and aspirate down to the top surface of the scaffold without pushing the tip to the bottom

steps.title: Wash Scaffolds with PBS
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL sterile PBS to each well containing a scaffold.

steps.title: Coat Scaffolds with Fibronectin
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the prepared fibronectin solution to each well containing a scaffold.

steps.title: Final Wash and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL sterile PBS to each scaffold well and incubate in the cell culture hood for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Trypsinize the cells, collect them as a suspension, and count them according to standard operating procedures.

steps.title: Seed Cells onto Scaffolds
steps.instruction: Seed the desired number of cells onto the scaffolds in complete growth medium (or medium of choice), ensuring each scaffold has a total volume of 100-200 μl.

substeps.instruction: Example for MEFs: Seed densities between 1,000 and 15,000 cells per 3.5 mm scaffold
Example for 1,000 cells/scaffold: Dilute cell suspension to 5,000 cells/ml and pipette 200 μl onto each scaffold

steps.title: Culture and Maintain Cells
steps.instruction: Culture the cells according to their specific requirements.

substeps.instruction: Allow cells to fully attach for at least two hours before performing any manipulations (e.g., changing medium)
Refresh the cell culture medium every 48 h
